messages:
maria: heads-up — saw a p99 spike on llm-serving after the kernel-selector tweak last night. Short seq chat paths hit a fallback path and latencies went up ~20%.
logan: saw similar in canary earlier, interesting. do we have selector logs?
pranav: can you paste the exact selector output + batcher decisions?
maria: pasted snippets below from selector + pprof. not full logs to keep thread small.
```
2026-03-17T02:12:01Z INFO selector: model=llama3-13b head_dim=96 hidden_size=12288 selected_kernel=mm_generic reasons=[head_dim!=64,rope_theta=default]
2026-03-17T02:12:01Z WARN batcher: forced_small_batch for seq<=8
```
logan: that first line is the smoking gun — head_dim=96 isn't covered by our optimized kernels for sm80. fallback to mm_generic is ~2-3x slower for small seqs.
zhen: added that trace: kv cache churned when chattemplate=prefixpad enabled. we see more KV evictions because we count entries, not bytes. bigger head_dim => bigger KV footprint -> earlier evict.
pranav: pprof top looked like:
```
60.2% runtime/mm_generic
12.1% runtime/kv_spill
7.5% runtime/rmsnorm_fwd
```
pranav: note on RMSNorm/SiLU: our fused SiLU+RMSNorm kernels assume head_dim aligned to 64. Llama2/3 variants with head_dim 96/128 break alignment and force fallback into unoptimized code paths.
logan: short term mitigation ideas:
- kernel aliasing: map 96->128 pad for matmul on small batches so we hit the 128-optimized kernel (cheap pad for seq<=32)
- batcher heuristic: avoid coalescing very short chats with long-running streams (split route)
- kv heuristic: switch from entry-count eviction -> byte-estimate eviction
- rope_theta: force legacy rope_theta for chat templates until we validate scaling impacts

maria: tested the aliasing + batcher tweak in canary: p99 dropped ~11% (240ms -> 214ms) and cpu time for mm_generic down 48%.
pranav: good. we should add a regression perf test matrix for head_dim variants (64, 96, 128) across short/long seq distributions so future selector changes don't regress.
zhen: I'll send a follow-up to make kv evict use bytes-based scoring and to add 'kv_reserve' header hint so callers can indicate expected cache size. That should reduce noisy evictions for bigger hidden sizes.
infra-bot: SLO alert INFER-564 auto-rollback executed on canary. Rolling patch PR to prod blocked until green. :white_check_mark:
logan: PR link: github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/4213 — includes kernel alias table, small-batch policy tweak, and a toggle for rope_theta per-model.
maria: plan: ship the alias + batcher change tonight behind feature-flag, monitor p99 and kv_evictions, then follow with kv eviction + perf tests next week. Join #oncall in 30 if you want to watch the rollout.
pranav: adding benchmark harness now (head_dim sweep + rope variants + chattemplate prefixpad). will push results to the PR.
zhen: also adding a unit that asserts RMSNorm fused kernel is used for expected head_dim alignments so we fail CI on accidental misalignment.
maria: thanks all — let's avoid another late-night SLO surprise. :rocket:
